headline: HuyenBao v11.15 — Phong Thuỷ Bát Trạch (八宅) integrated from Huyen-Hoc-AI
summary: Third Huyen-Hoc-AI feature brought into the main app: a simplified Bát Trạch (八宅 / Eight Mansions feng-shui) reading in the Spirit tab, alongside Kinh Dịch and Tử Vi. The full deterministic engine — Kua number (cung phi) from birth date + gender via digit-sum, Bát Trạch table mapping all 8 directions to their cung-vi (Sinh Khí / Thiên Y / Diên Niên / Phục Vị / Tuyệt Mệnh / Ngũ Quỷ / Lục Sát / Họa Hại) for each of the 9 Kua numbers, house/kitchen/bedroom direction match, niên phi tinh (annual flying star via Lo Shu), and phi tinh bảy cung (9 flying stars across center + 8 directions) — is ported verbatim from the Huyen-Hoc-AI FastAPI backend to TypeScript (src/lib/phongthuy.ts) and runs client-side. A new /api/phongthuy endpoint interprets the reading through the app's existing local LLM (Ollama, same client as /api/story, /api/divine, and /api/tuvi), falling back to ZAI cloud then to a deterministic local reading. The reading uses the character's birth year + month plus the day, gender, and house/kitchen/bedroom directions the player enters in the panel — no save-state change. Two JS-isms were handled in the port: (1) Python's `%` always returns non-negative for a positive divisor, JS `%` preserves the sign of the dividend — fixed with the standard `((x % n) + n) % n` idiom in tinhNienPhiTinh and phiTinhBayCung (same fix as the v11.14 Tử Vi port); (2) JS Date.UTC maps years 0–99 to 1900–1999, breaking dates like year=1 — replaced with a manual Gregorian date validator. The reading is a simplified reference per the source disclaimer; it may differ from a given phong thuỷ school.
features: New Phong Thuỷ panel in the Spirit tab: birth-day + gender + house/kitchen/bedroom direction inputs → full Bát Trạch reading (Kua number, quai, East/West group, 4 good directions, 4 bad directions, house/kitchen/bedroom cung-vi matches with reference scores, today's flying-star centre, LLM interpretation + reflection)

src/lib/phongthuy.ts: full deterministic engine ported from Huyen-Hoc-AI — HUONG (8 directions), CUNG_PHI_QUAI (1–9 → name), BAT_TRACH_TABLE (9×8 verbatim from source), CUU_TINH (9 flying-star metadata), tinhCungPhi (digit-sum Kua), huongTotXau, hopHuong, tinhNienPhiTinh (Lo Shu), phiTinhBayCung, phiTinhNgay, phanTichToanDien

POST /api/phongthuy: LLM interpretation via the existing Ollama connection, ZAI cloud fallback, deterministic local-reading fallback — always returns a reading in the player's language; focuses on house direction match + 4 good directions + today's flying-star centre

Direction grid: 4 good directions in sage (green) + 4 bad in brick (red); house/kitchen/bedroom match row shows direction → cung-vi with good/bad tag + reference score; today's flying-star centre labelled with star name + element
Uses character's byear + birthMonth (no save migration); day + gender + directions entered in-panel per reading
JS modulo fix (Python `%` non-negative vs JS `%` signed) applied to tinhNienPhiTinh and phiTinhBayCung
JS Date.UTC year-0-99 mapping replaced with manual Gregorian date validator — handles year=1 correctly (matches Python date(1,1,1))
Disclaimer notes (ghi_chu + disc.aiNote) shown under every reading
Version bumped to v11.15 on homepage header + version.json
